events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Prompt Gallery - Company-wide prompt publishing
events.titleJa: Copilot プロンプト ギャラリー - 全社的なプロンプト公開
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Prompt Gallery - Company-wide prompt publishing
events.summary: Organizations can build their own collections of prompts that are tailored to their business needs and workflows and distribute these to all users within the tenant.

Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling...

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
events.titleJa: Copilot ダッシュボードのインテリジェントな概要
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
events.summary: Use intelligent summaries in Copilot Dashboard to quickly surface what’s working and where targeted attention can accelerate Copilot adoption. Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success. Suggested prompts enable deeper exploration of underlying trends and drivers.
events.summaryJa: Copilot ダッシュボードのインテリジェントな概要を使用して、何が機能しているのか、どこに的を絞った注意が Copilot の導入を促進できるのかをすぐに明らかにします。 Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success.提案されたプロンプトにより、根本的な傾向と推進要因をより深く調査できます。
